DevopsRequestInfo.name: DevopsRequestInfo
DevopsRequestInfo.description: Represents a specific request for a DevOps Center operation, such as a commit, deploy, promotion, rebase, or back sync, and tracks its overall status and outcome.

ErrorDetails.description: Provides detailed information if the requested operation encounters an error.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly, for example, through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, and LastReferenceDate is not null, the user accessed this record or list view indirectly.

Message.description: A status message or summary description regarding the current state of the request.

Name.description: The unique identifier for the request info record.

OperationType.description: Indicates the specific type of DevOps Center action performed.

OwnerId.description: The ID of the owner of this record.

ParentRequestInfoId.description: The ID of a parent request info record, used for tracking related or suboperations.

RequestCompletionDate.description: The date and time when the requested operation was completed.

RequestToken.description: A unique token used to correlate the request with external source control systems or event processing.

Status.description: The current state of the DevOps request.
